actions.metabase_update_document.descrip: Rename, rewrite, move or archive a document.
actions.metabase_update_document.props.a: Yes moves the document to the trash, No restores it. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_document.props.c: Move to this collection. Empty = unchanged.
Rich content as a ProseMirror document, e.g. {"type": "doc", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Hello"}]}]}. Replaces the body. Set this or Text, not both.
actions.metabase_update_document.props.d: Numeric ID of the document. Get it from List Documents or Search.
actions.metabase_update_document.props.t: Plain-text content; blank lines separate paragraphs. Replaces the body. Set this or Content, not both.
actions.metabase_update_field.props.fiel: Numeric ID of the field (column). Get it from Get Table Metadata or List Database Fields.
actions.metabase_update_field.props.fkTa: With semantic type type/FK: the field this column points to. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_field.props.hasF: How filters on this field offer values. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_field.props.sema: e.g. type/Category, type/Email, type/FK, type/PK, type/Currency. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_field.props.sett: Formatting settings object, e.g. {"currency": "EUR"}. Replaces the existing settings. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_field.props.visi: Where the field shows. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_field_values.des: Set custom display names for a field's values.
actions.metabase_update_field_values.pro: Numeric ID of the field (column). Get it from Get Table Metadata or List Database Fields.
actions.metabase_update_glossary_entry.d: Replace a glossary term and its definition.
actions.metabase_update_glossary_entry.p: Numeric ID of the glossary entry. Get it from List Glossary Entries.
actions.metabase_update_segment.props.ar: Yes archives the segment, No restores it. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_segment.props.de: New filter definition (MBQL, same shape as Create Segment). Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_segment.props.re: Why the change was made, kept in the history. Required by Metabase.
actions.metabase_update_segment.props.se: Numeric ID of the segment. Get it from List Segments.
actions.metabase_update_snippet.descript: Change or archive a SQL snippet.
actions.metabase_update_snippet.props.ar: Yes archives the snippet, No restores it. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_snippet.props.sn: Numeric ID of the SQL snippet. Get it from List Snippets.
actions.metabase_update_table.props.cave: Things users should know about this table. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_table.props.fiel: How columns are ordered. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_table.props.poin: What is useful about this table. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_table.props.tabl: Numeric ID of the table. Get it from List Tables, List Schema Tables or Search.
actions.metabase_update_table.props.visi: Hide the table from users. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_timeline.descrip: Rename, move or archive a timeline.
actions.metabase_update_timeline.props.a: Yes archives the timeline, No restores it. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_timeline.props.c: Move to this collection. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_timeline.props.i: Icon shown on charts. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_timeline.props.t: Numeric ID of the timeline. Get it from List Timelines.
actions.metabase_update_timeline_event.d: Change, move or archive a timeline event.
actions.metabase_update_timeline_event.p: Yes archives the event, No restores it. Empty = unchanged.
Numeric ID of the timeline event. Get it from Get Timeline (with events).
Move the event to this timeline. Empty = unchanged.
New IANA time zone. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_user.description: Update a user's name, email, locale or admin status.
actions.metabase_update_user.props.isSup: Yes makes the user an admin, No removes admin. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_user.props.local: Language code such as en or de. Empty = unchanged.
actions.metabase_update_user.props.userI: Numeric ID of the Metabase user. Get it from List Users or Get Current User.
auth.description: Metabase authentication requires a baseUrl and a password.
auth.props.apiKey.description: Generate one on your Metabase instance (settings -> authentication -> API keys)
auth.props.embeddingKey.description: Needed if you want to generate a graph of a question (settings -> embedding -> static embedding).
description: The simplest way to ask questions and learn from data
